verdict.rationale: The evidence only says Parsec's connection data path is peer-to-peer and avoids Parsec's infrastructure. That is adjacent to this story, not delivery of it. Nothing documents local-network host discovery or connecting without an account, and the references to MFA and password login suggest an account is part of the flow.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between

citations.quote: All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
